scheme_name: The Scheme Of State Award For Disabled
description:
The Scheme of State Award for Disabled is an initiative by the Government of India aimed at recognizing and promoting the rights and welfare of persons with disabilities.

This scheme was launched on December 3, 2013, coinciding with the International Day of Persons with Disabilities.

The primary objective of the scheme is to honor individuals with disabilities who have made significant contributions in various fields.

The scheme aims to encourage persons with disabilities to excel in their respective domains and to inspire others in the community.

The awards are given to individuals with disabilities who have demonstrated exceptional achievements in fields such as education, sports, arts, and social work.

The scheme also seeks to raise awareness about the capabilities of persons with disabilities and to promote inclusivity in society.

The awards are categorized into different levels based on the achievements of the candidates.

The awards include cash prizes and certificates of recognition.

The cash prizes for the award winners vary based on the category of the award.

For example, the first prize may amount to INR 1,00,000.

The second prize may be INR 50,000.

The third prize may be INR 25,000.

In addition to the cash prizes, awardees receive a citation and a medal.

The eligibility criteria for the scheme include being a resident of India.

Applicants must have a recognized disability as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

The age limit for applicants is generally set at 18 years and above.

There is no upper age limit specified for the applicants.

Candidates must demonstrate outstanding achievements in their respective fields.

The application process requires candidates to fill out a detailed application form.

The application form can typically be obtained from the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

Applicants must submit proof of their disability.

This proof should be in the form of a disability certificate issued by a competent authority.

Candidates must also provide documentation of their achievements.

This may include certificates, awards, or any other relevant documents that highlight their contributions.

The completed application form and supporting documents must be submitted to the designated authority.

The designated authority is usually the Department of Social Welfare in the respective state.

The application deadline is generally announced annually.

It is important for applicants to keep track of the specific dates for submission.

The evaluation of applications is conducted by a committee formed by the state government.

This committee comprises experts in various fields related to disability.

The committee reviews the applications based on the criteria set forth in the scheme.

The awards are typically announced on International Day of Persons with Disabilities.

This day is celebrated on December 3 every year.

The disbursement of cash prizes and distribution of certificates occurs during a formal ceremony.

The ceremony is usually organized by the Department of Social Welfare.

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The ministry is responsible for ensuring the welfare and rights of persons with disabilities.

The contact details for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment can be found on their official website.

The scheme also aligns with the goals of the National Policy for Persons with Disabilities.

This policy aims to create an inclusive society for persons with disabilities.

The scheme encourages states to promote similar initiatives at the local level.

The awards serve as a motivation for persons with disabilities to pursue their goals.

The recognition helps in reducing stigma associated with disabilities.

The scheme has been instrumental in highlighting the achievements of individuals with disabilities.

It also fosters a sense of community and support among persons with disabilities.

The government has allocated specific budgets for the implementation of the scheme.

These budgets are utilized for organizing award ceremonies and providing cash prizes.

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders.

It has been praised for its role in empowering persons with disabilities.

The awards have also led to increased visibility for issues faced by persons with disabilities.

The scheme encourages collaboration between government agencies and civil society organizations.

This collaboration helps in reaching out to a wider audience.

The scheme is part of a broader framework of welfare initiatives for persons with disabilities.

It complements other schemes such as the Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances.

The impact of the scheme can be measured through the number of applications received each year.

In recent years, the number of applicants has steadily increased.

This indicates a growing awareness and participation among persons with disabilities.

The scheme also aims to create role models within the disabled community.

These role models can inspire others to overcome challenges and achieve their goals.

The recognition provided by the scheme can lead to further opportunities for awardees.

Many awardees have reported increased support and recognition in their respective fields after receiving the award.

The scheme is an important step towards building a more inclusive society.

It reflects the commitment of the Indian government to the rights and welfare of persons with disabilities.

The scheme is expected to continue evolving to better serve the needs of the disabled community.

Future enhancements may include increased cash prizes and more categories for awards.

The government is also exploring ways to integrate technology into the application process.

This could streamline the process and make it more accessible for applicants.

Overall, the Scheme of State Award for Disabled is a significant initiative that recognizes and celebrates the contributions of persons with disabilities in India.
